long: The Operative: No One Lives Forever is a 2000 first-person shooter with stealth elements set in a 1960s spy-fiction world. Players control secret agent Cate Archer, using gadgets, disguises, and weapons to thwart a criminal organization. It is celebrated for its witty writing, humor, and stylish Cold War espionage atmosphere.
